name: dillon-floor-by-floor-model-20260712
goal: Extract the Dillon main, upper, and detached toy-garage wall geometry from the actual architectural DWGs, corroborate scale and vertical controls against the matching PDFs, bind vertical placement to source floor, ceiling, and roof-framing datums, build top, side/elevation, and source-grounded 3D wall-extrusion views without guessed floor heights, and expose the result in the authenticated Studio.
exit_criteria: Main, upper, and toy-garage plan scale is bound to DWG inches divided by 12 and corroborated by each sheet's printed 3/16 inch equals 1 foot notation
Every modeled wall solid is extracted from its matching architectural DWG Wall-Hatch boundary rather than synthesized from sprinkler linework or an automatic PDF outline
Main floor model elevation 0 ft and upper floor model elevation 12.5 ft are bound to the upper-plan dual datums 112 ft 6 in and project elevation 1537 ft
Toy-garage model elevation is bound to its project finish floor 1503 ft and the main-house project datum rather than a default story offset
Ceiling and roof controls use source RCP and framing annotations including 9/10/11.5/16.5 ft ceiling heights, 3:12 roof slope, and explicit beam or plate elevations
Top, side/elevation, and 3D model outputs numerically agree on wall geometry, floor elevations, nominal wall-extrusion heights, and roof-control annotations
Adversarial mutations to source hashes, scale, footprint, floor datum, ceiling datum, or roof slope fail closed
Authenticated API and Studio surface the source-derived model, its limitations, and per-level visibility without claiming code compliance or fabrication readiness
Focused tests, production build, loop guard, rules verifier, live login, browser, and VPS health checks pass
